title: The Orphan's Return
description: A journey of reclaiming belonging after abandonment. The traveler discovers that the home they seek was never a place — it was the capacity to hold themselves.

acts.title: The Empty Hearth
acts.description: The traveler wakes in a cold stone house with no doors. Echoes of voices that left.

acts.title: The Bridge of Names
acts.description: A bridge appears, carved with the names of everyone who stayed and everyone who left. The traveler must choose which names to carry.

acts.title: The Homecoming
acts.description: The traveler builds a fire in an open field. Others appear — drawn to the warmth. Home was never behind them.
